exit=0
--stdout--
#compdef hydra-cli
_hydra_cli() {
    local -a top_level config_sub fleet_sub manifest_sub options
    top_level=(version help status robots claims claim release limits jog-arm jog table robot audit doctor config shell completion login logout scan fleet stop stop-all metrics manifest connections liveness ecosystem-health plan-simulate)
    config_sub=(validate apply)
    fleet_sub=(doctor)
    manifest_sub=(validate)
    options=(--server --config --timeout --json --help)
    if (( CURRENT == 2 )); then
        compadd -a top_level
        return
    fi
    if [[ ${words[2]} == "config" && $CURRENT -eq 3 ]]; then
        compadd -a config_sub
        return
    fi
    if [[ ${words[2]} == "fleet" && $CURRENT -eq 3 ]]; then
        compadd -a fleet_sub
        return
    fi
    if [[ ${words[2]} == "manifest" && $CURRENT -eq 3 ]]; then
        compadd -a manifest_sub
        return
    fi
    if [[ ${words[CURRENT]} == -* ]]; then
        compadd -a options
    fi
}
compdef _hydra_cli hydra-cli
--stderr--
